name: AXM Studio
summary: One complete 2D and interface workspace with ten focused modes, editable vector objects, a timed pixel-animation timeline, integrated UI/UX and skin production, and direct Asset Vault image-to-layer handoff.
notes: Studio v2.2 adds honest shell-to-engine saves, lazy specialist modes, frame-safe animation metadata, vector undo/redo and a gated, versioned Asset Vault handoff with source provenance. Existing routes and stored data remain compatible.
